name: xrm-csv-workflow
description: This repository provides a performant way to convert CSV files to RDF.

scripts.xrm:bootstrap: node lib/duck2xrm.js xrm-csv-workflow.duckdb -s mappings/sources.xrm -v mappings/vocabularies.xrm -m mappings/mappings.xrm
scripts.rdf:create: mkdir -p output && ${ONTOP_BIN:-./bin/ontop/ontop} materialize -f ntriples -o ./output/transformed.nt -p xrm-csv-workflow.properties -m src-gen/mappings.r2rml.ttl
scripts.rdf:validate: RVV=${RVV_BIN:-rvv}; if command -v "$RVV" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$RVV" validate output/transformed.nt; else echo "rvv not found, skipping vocabulary validation (https://github.com/ktk/vocab-validator)"; fi
